title: Gate deploy-factory.yml on green CI and a protected environment
description:
The Factory deploy workflow can run without CI being green and without a protected environment gate.

Low severity today because deploys are manual and infrequent. It stops being low the moment Phase 5 puts a real epic on a deployed Factory, because then a bad deploy breaks a running epic rather than a test account.

From pxc, finding d052884e.
acceptance_criteria: deploy-factory.yml requires green CI and a protected environment approval before deploying
